name: @hoardodile/desktop
description: Cross-platform Electron shell around the hoardodile Fastify sidecar.
author: wooloo26

scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs
scripts.package:publish: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --x64 --publish always && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --dir --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs --target linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --x64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --platform linux && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs --platform linux
scripts.package:publish:linux: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs --target linux && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux --x64 --publish always && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --platform linux && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs --platform linux
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs --target mac --arch arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --platform mac && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs --platform mac
scripts.package:publish:mac: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs --target mac --arch arm64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --arm64 --publish always && node scripts/verify-package.mjs --platform mac && node ../../scripts/verify-feed.mjs --platform mac
